example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার ব্যাগ থেকে সবকিছু নিয়ে নিয়েছে, সেরকে পশুরি চুরি হয়েছে।
দোকানদারটি দাম বাড়িয়ে সেরকে পশুরি চুরি করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He took everything from my bag; it was like stealing five seers in one.
The shopkeeper is overcharging, committing daylight robbery.
history: The idiom references the traditional Bengali unit of weight 'seer' (approximately 1 kg), highlighting excessive dishonesty in trade or theft, rooted in pre-metric era practices.
note: The idiom uses hyperbole based on the impossibility of stealing more than the measured amount, emphasizing deceit.
